messages:
alice_cs: Heads-up: StratusX kicked off an APAC pilot and immediately hit per-minute throttles. They asked for a temporary CIDR exception + higher burst for /v1/chat.

rachel_acct: Flagging renewal risk if pilot stalls. They requested a 12-day test window and proposed burst=520 rps from their staging CIDR.

alice_cs: @tom_net can you add their staging CIDRs 203.0.114.0/28 and 198.51.101.0/27 to an edge allowlist? They also want header match X-Client:StratusX-Stag. mTLS is a later ask.

tom_net: I can do ipset entries + a temporary rate window. Recommend auto-revoke TTL=12d. Any global caps?

rachel_acct: Keep global soft cap lowish since it's just a pilot: per-route burst=520, global_soft=650.

ben_sre: @alice_cs tagging SRE review. I'll run a noisy-neighbor and capacity check. If enabled, plan to attach small-model fallback on overload. ETA 40m for review.

preflight-bot: Preflight results: APAC status clear. Recommend KV prewarm for stratusx prefix. Suggest p95 alert at 1400ms.

 tom_net: Draft change snippet:

```
# StratusX temp allowlist + rate window (auto-revoke 12d)
ipset add stratusx_203 203.0.114.0/28
ipset add stratusx_198 198.51.101.0/27
route /v1/chat burst=520 per_route_soft=520 global_soft=650 headers.allow=X-Client:StratusX-Stag
# tag: stratusx-pilot-3305559999
```

 tom_net: Opening JIRA INF-7501. Rollback scheduled for 2026-04-22 (auto-revoke). I'll include webhook to remove ipset after TTL.

alice_cs: Capture customer telem: they saw 250-350ms median in us-west but 900-1300ms p95 in ap-northeast during spikes. They asked if region pin to ap-northeast-1 is possible.

ben_sre: We can add a token-level routing policy to pin to ap-northeast-1. That reduces latency but increases egress/cost. I'll produce a cost delta for @rachel_acct.

rachel_acct: Send cost delta before enabling pin. Also note in renewal tracker that CS granted a pilot concession.

alice_cs: Scheduling a 45m enablement + runbook review with docs this Friday to validate prompts and monitor quality under load. We'll watch hallucination rate with the burst.

tom_net: Change queued pending SRE signoff. INF-7501 created.

ben_sre: Applied change to staging; smoke tests green. Rolling to prod in 8. Alerts set: p95 > 1600ms triggers rollback + small-model fallback.

alice_cs: :thumbsup: ping me when live so i can notify StratusX and run the Friday session. Adding renewal note: "APAC pilot latency risk; concession applied".

tom_net: Live. CIDRs allowed, rate window active, header match enforced. Watchlist created: stratusx-3305559999.

alice_cs: We'll review telemetry at 24h and capture sentiment + any quality regressions.

rachel_acct: I'll prepare usage + cost summary for day 9 and follow up on renewal outreach.

alice_cs: Thanks team.
